Name: RE: Get to Schol on Time
Overview: RE: Get to Schol on Time is a cult-classic, retro comedy adventure indie game developed by GHXYK2 that follows a student named Fuller on a frantic, surreal journey through 2003 England as he races against the clock to make it to school. It is famous for its extreme, unforgiving difficulty and bizarre satire of early-2000s UK school culture, split into five distinct, chaotic gameplay styles representing different school years—ranging from a strict art class simulation and hardcore platformer to a physics challenge involving soup-filled balloons and a brutal bottle-smashing finale.
